findings.title: OS Command Injection via Filename
findings.trigger: Filename containing a command separator like ';' or '|'
findings.assumptions: The filename is attacker-controlled or derived from user input and the program runs in an environment where the filename is interpreted as a command.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SVG Tag
findings.trigger: Special characters like '<', '>', '"', or '/' in fillColor, strokeColor, or markerStart
findings.assumptions: The input strings are attacker-controlled or derived from user input and are directly embedded into the SVG file without any validation or escaping.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SVG Attribute
findings.trigger: Special characters like '<', '>', '"', or '/' in markerId
findings.assumptions: The markerId is attacker-controlled or derived from user input and is directly embedded into the SVG file without any validation or escaping.

findings.title: OS Command Injection via Path Attribute
findings.trigger: Path data containing a command separator like ';' or '|'
findings.assumptions: The path data is attacker-controlled or derived from user input and the program runs in an environment where the path data is interpreted as a command.
